title: Skip a mandatory verifier appraisal gate
preconditions: one verifier flow received hostile or opaque evidence
steps: omit one of challenge authentication, freshness, identity, evidence, session binding, revocation, or policy satisfaction
request completion or present a report-only allow decision
construct a freely built failure AppraisalResultView and attempt to use either report as an AppraisalResult
invariants: only the canonical seven-gate path can create VerifiedAttestation
only consuming conversion of the completed VerifiedAttestation can create an allowed AppraisalResult
Decision VerificationOutcome and a freely built failure AppraisalResultView are reporting data rather than result authority
residual_risk: a deliberately compromised trusted gate producer remains inside the verifier TCB
